svg.title: Employment structural transformation, six locked country cases, 1991 (proxy for 1990) and 2020
svg.desc: Share of total employment by broad sector, agriculture, industry, services, at two years. Ghana, 1991: agriculture 71.8 percent, industry 9.0 percent, services 19.2 percent. 2020: agriculture 37.4 percent, industry 15.2 percent, services 47.4 percent. Botswana, 1991: agriculture 12.6 percent, industry 21.3 percent, services 66.1 percent. 2020: agriculture 19.5 percent, industry 15.0 percent, services 65.5 percent. Mauritius, 1991: agriculture 19.6 percent, industry 35.0 percent, services 45.4 percent. 2020: agriculture 5.3 percent, industry 23.4 percent, services 71.3 percent. South Korea, 1991: agriculture 15.5 percent, industry 37.1 percent, services 47.4 percent. 2020: agriculture 5.4 percent, industry 24.6 percent, services 70.0 percent. Malaysia, 1991: agriculture 18.9 percent, industry 32.8 percent, services 48.3 percent. 2020: agriculture 10.5 percent, industry 26.2 percent, services 63.3 percent. Philippines, 1991: agriculture 44.1 percent, industry 16.6 percent, services 39.3 percent. 2020: agriculture 24.5 percent, industry 18.7 percent, services 56.8 percent. Each column sums to one hundred by the dictionary rule. 1991 is a plus-one proxy for the requested 1990 anchor. The 1960 anchor is excluded because the three-sector ILO modelled series has no harmonised 1960 observation. The 2020 observation is the COVID-19 year. The chart observes anchors only and does not estimate values between years. Gaps and shifts do not identify whether culture, policy, institutions, war, aid, or any other factor caused them. Not a race.
svg.metadata: VIS-007 Employment structural transformation. Indicators SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, SL.IND.EMPL.ZS, SL.SRV.EMPL.ZS. Source SRC-WDI-001 (World Development Indicators, ILO modelled estimates). WDI release 2026-07-13; retrieved 2026-10-06. Frozen master: data/master/six_country_chart_inputs.csv. Frozen chart data: data/charts/employment_structural_transformation.csv. Specification: design/figures/EMPLOYMENT_STRUCTURAL_TRANSFORMATION_SPEC.md. Scale: 1 percent = 3.0 units; plot height = 300 units; stack order from bottom up is agriculture, industry, services. Display shares use the dictionary one-decimal sum-to-100 rule and sum exactly to 100.0 per country-year.

svg.text: OBSERVED ANCHORS ONLY
Each bar is one dated observation. The chart does not
estimate values between 1991 and 2020 and does not
extrapolate before 1991 or after 2020.
VISIBLE CAVEATS
† 1991 is a plus-one proxy for the requested 1990 anchor.
2020 is the COVID-19 year for all six economies. No 1960
observation exists in the ILO modelled three-sector series.
WHAT THIS COMPARISON CANNOT PROVE
Gaps and shifts do not identify whether culture, policy,
institutions, war, aid, or any other factor caused them. Not
a race. The chart does not identify a cause.
Note. Share of total employment by broad sector (agriculture, industry, services), 1991 (proxy for 1990) and 2020. Data from World Development Indicators, ILO modelled estimates (SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS,
SL.IND.EMPL.ZS, SL.SRV.EMPL.ZS), by World Bank (2026). WDI DataBank. SRC-WDI-001 . WDI release 2026-07-13; retrieved 2026-10-06 . Frozen CSV: data/charts/employment_structural_transformation.csv.
